_comment: Porter MCP server for Windsurf (Cascade). HOW TO APPLY: merge the mcpServers.porter block into ~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json (create the file if absent). Replace {{PORTER_TOKEN}} with a real Porter access token. IMPORTANT: Windsurf requires a FULL RESTART (not just reload) to pick up MCP config changes. NOTE: Windsurf was renamed Devin Desktop (2026-06); new installs should use devin-mcp_config.json (~/.config/devin/mcp_config.json) instead — this file is kept for existing Cascade installs. UNVERIFIED: not tested against a live Windsurf install here.
